title: Choose the revised Xerom homepage
question: All three keep Race Control Broadcast, remove the leaderboard, add replaceable Regular/Pro/PS5 image modules, make the cafe visible, and include a separately composed mobile version. Choose the replacement structure that should carry forward.

options.label: Crew Invitation
options.lineage: Race Control Broadcast with a social invitation rail
options.thesis: The left rail tells groups why to come together before the hardware and prices close the decision.
options.viewport: Bring Your Crew replaces the leaderboard; the social hero dominates, four service/cafe frames prove the offer, and mobile becomes a hero-led vertical feed.
options.risk: The social benefit labels may repeat what the hero already communicates.

options.label: Tonight at Xerom
options.lineage: Race Control Broadcast with a live venue pulse
options.thesis: Race, Play and Refuel become the three clear modes of a complete Xerom night.
options.viewport: A compact Race/Play/Refuel pulse replaces the leaderboard; product frames and cafe proof create a balanced venue overview on desktop and mobile.
options.risk: Status-marker styling must not imply live availability unless the data is real.

options.label: Race · Play · Refuel
options.lineage: Race Control Broadcast with a numbered night itinerary
options.thesis: A three-step night gives the cafe a natural role without weakening the racing focus.
options.viewport: Numbered Race, Play and Refuel moments replace the leaderboard; four modular proof frames sit below and the mobile layout preserves the same sequence.
options.risk: The itinerary can feel more explanatory and slightly less spontaneous than the other revisions.
